Operator i primena

Ovi uslovi uređuju javni ISI portal Instituta za socijalnu inkluziju. Tehnički operator je GoraNova. Registrovani naziv operatora, adrese, registar i PIB: [PODATAK U PRIPREMI]. Kontakt: institutzasocijalnuinkluziju@gmail.com. SIMPA i ORDO pristup zahteva zasebno institucionalno ovlašćenje; ovi uslovi ne dodeljuju nalog ili licencu.

Dozvoljena upotreba

Javni sadržaj koristite zakonito, uz poštovanje izvora, autorstva i licence pojedinačnog materijala. Zabranjeni su neovlašćen pristup, zaobilaženje kontrola, ometanje rada, zlonamerni kod i objava tuđih podataka bez ovlašćenja.

Sadržaj i institucionalne odluke

Sadržaj služi informisanju i istraživanju. Analitika i AI izlazi zahtevaju proveru izvora, metodologije i ljudsku stručnu procenu. Ne predstavljaju garantovane rezultate, pravni savet ili automatsku institucionalnu odluku. Spoljni linkovi podležu uslovima njihovih operatora.

Prava i dostupnost

Prava autora i trećih lica ostaju njihovim nosiocima. Javna dostupnost ne znači neograničenu licencu. Sadržaj može biti ažuriran ili uklonjen radi tačnosti, bezbednosti ili prava trećih lica. Ne garantuje se neprekidna dostupnost; obavezna zakonska prava i odgovornosti nisu isključeni.

Nalozi i email

Korisnici čuvaju pristupne podatke i koriste samo dodeljena ovlašćenja. SIMPA i ORDO podaci ostaju u organizacionim granicama. Produkcioni SMTP je pending; email pozivi, verifikacija i reset nisu dostupni. Problemi se prijavljuju bez lozinki, tokena i poverljivih dokumenata.

Privatnost, pravo i izmene

Obrada je opisana u Obaveštenju o privatnosti. Pitanja i zahteve šaljite na kontakt email. Ugovorna strana, precizno merodavno pravo i nadležnost: [PODATAK U PRIPREMI]; obavezna prava ostaju primenljiva. Verzija se menja objavom novih uslova. Srpski tekst je osnovni; engleski je prevod, uz očuvanje obaveznih prava.

Operator and scope

These terms cover the public ISI portal of the Institute for Social Inclusion. GoraNova is the technical operator. Its registered entity, addresses, registration and tax numbers: [INFORMATION PENDING]. Contact: institutzasocijalnuinkluziju@gmail.com. SIMPA and ORDO access requires separate institutional authorization; these terms do not grant an account or licence.

Permitted use

Use public materials lawfully and respect each item’s source, authorship and licence. Unauthorized access, bypassing controls, disrupting services, malicious code and disclosure of data without authorization are prohibited.

Content and institutional decisions

Content supports information and research. Analytics and AI outputs require source, methodology and professional human review. They are not guaranteed outcomes, legal advice or automatic institutional decisions. External links follow their operators’ terms.

Rights and availability

Authors and third parties retain their rights. Public availability does not grant an unrestricted licence. Content may be corrected or removed for accuracy, security or third-party rights. Uninterrupted availability is not guaranteed; mandatory legal rights and liabilities are not excluded.

Accounts and email

Users protect credentials and stay within assigned permissions. SIMPA and ORDO records remain within organizational boundaries. Production SMTP is pending; invitation, verification and reset email delivery is unavailable. Report issues without passwords, tokens or confidential documents.

Privacy, law and changes

Processing is described in the Privacy Notice. Send questions and requests to the contact email. Contracting entity, precise governing law and jurisdiction: [INFORMATION PENDING]; mandatory rights remain applicable. Updated terms are published with a version. Serbian is the primary text; English is a translation, without limiting mandatory rights.

Ko smo i kontakt

Institut za socijalnu inkluziju predstavlja ISI. Tehnički operator je GoraNova; puni registrovani naziv operatora, registrovane adrese, registracioni i poreski brojevi: [PODATAK U PRIPREMI]. Kontakt za privatnost: institutzasocijalnuinkluziju@gmail.com. Tačne uloge rukovaoca i obrađivača po obradi: [PODATAK U PRIPREMI].

Obuhvat i svrhe

Javni portal pruža institucionalne informacije. Platforma sadrži odvojene proizvode SIMPA i ORDO i organizacione radne prostore. Nalozi koriste email, prikazno ime i hash lozinke; sesije i bezbednosne evidencije služe autentifikaciji, kontroli pristupa i sprečavanju zloupotreba. Podaci radnih prostora obrađuju se u okviru ovlašćenja organizacije. Pravni osnov za svaku konkretnu svrhu i eventualne posebne kategorije podataka: [PODATAK U PRIPREMI].

Email i pristup

Pristup platformi je pozivni; javni portal ne zahteva nalog. Produkcioni SMTP je pending. Slanje novih pozivnica, verifikacionih i reset poruka nije dostupno dok se servis ne aktivira. Ne šaljite lozinke, tokene ili institucionalne podatke na kontakt email.

Primaoci, hosting i prenosi

Ovlašćeni administrator i operator mogu pristupati podacima radi održavanja u okviru odobrenih ovlašćenja. Hosting pravno lice, lokacije podataka i rezervnih kopija, ugovori, podobrađivači i međunarodni prenosi: [PODATAK U PRIPREMI]. Kontakt mailbox koristi Gmail. Osetljiva SIMPA obrada prati lokalnu AI politiku; AI izlazi zahtevaju ljudsku proveru i ne predstavljaju institucionalnu odluku.

Kolačići i browser memorija

Aplikacija koristi tehnologije potrebne za sesiju i pristup. Konačni inventar kolačića, lokalne memorije, trajanja i ugrađenih resursa: [PODATAK U PRIPREMI]. Ne tvrdimo da portal nema kolačiće. Opcionu analitiku ili marketing treba posebno evidentirati i urediti pre aktiviranja.

Čuvanje i brisanje

Operativni ciljevi su 30 dana za dijagnostiku, 180 dana za bezbednosne događaje, pregled zastarelih sesija/tokena u roku od 30 dana, 12 meseci nakon zatvaranja podrške i 35 dana za rolling backup. To su ciljevi politike, a ne potvrda da je svako automatsko brisanje aktivno. Radni prostori prate posebne organizacione politike i legal hold; institucionalni podaci se ne brišu blanket pravilom. Stvarna enforcement evidencija i rokovi po obradi: [PODATAK U PRIPREMI].

Bezbednost i prava

Platforma koristi kontrolu pristupa i granice organizacije/proizvoda; nijedan sistem ne garantuje apsolutnu bezbednost. U zavisnosti od zakonskih uslova možete tražiti pristup, kopiju, ispravku, brisanje, ograničenje, prenosivost ili prigovor, kao i povlačenje saglasnosti kada se obrada na njoj zasniva. Zahteve pošaljite na navedeni kontakt. Identitet se proverava srazmerno; podaci radnog prostora mogu zahtevati postupanje njegove organizacije. Možete podneti pritužbu Povereniku Republike Srbije. Status imenovanog lica za zaštitu podataka i poštanski kanal: [PODATAK U PRIPREMI].

Deca i promene

Pravila za naloge maloletnika i obradu podataka dece: [PODATAK U PRIPREMI]. Posebne kategorije i podaci dece zahtevaju zasebnu procenu i zakonito ovlašćenje. Izmene se objavljuju sa verzijom i datumom; za kontakt koristite navedeni email.

Identity and contact

The Institute for Social Inclusion (Institut za socijalnu inkluziju) represents ISI. GoraNova is the technical operator. Its full registered entity, registered addresses, registration and tax numbers: [INFORMATION PENDING]. Privacy contact: institutzasocijalnuinkluziju@gmail.com. Controller and processor roles for each activity: [INFORMATION PENDING].

Scope and purposes

The public portal provides institutional information. SIMPA and ORDO are separate products with organization workspaces. Accounts use email, display name and a password hash. Sessions and security records support authentication, access control and abuse prevention. Workspace processing follows organizational permissions. The lawful basis for each purpose and any special categories of data: [INFORMATION PENDING].

Email and access

Platform access is invitation based; public pages do not require an account. Production SMTP is pending. New invitation, verification and password-reset messages are unavailable until delivery is activated. Do not send passwords, tokens or institutional data to the contact mailbox.

Recipients, hosting and transfers

Authorized administrators and the operator may access data for maintenance within approved permissions. Hosting entity, data and backup locations, processing agreements, subprocessors and international transfers: [INFORMATION PENDING]. The contact mailbox uses Gmail. Sensitive SIMPA processing follows local AI policy. AI outputs require human review and are not institutional decisions.

Cookies and browser storage

The application uses technologies needed for sessions and access. The final inventory of cookies, browser storage, duration and embedded resources: [INFORMATION PENDING]. We do not claim that the portal is cookie free. Optional analytics or marketing require separate assessment and controls before activation.

Retention and deletion

Policy targets are 30 days for diagnostics, 180 days for security events, review of obsolete sessions/tokens within 30 days, 12 months after support closure and a rolling 35-day backup window. These are policy targets, not confirmation that every automatic deletion control operates. Workspace records follow specific organizational policies and legal holds; institutional records are not subject to blanket deletion. Actual enforcement evidence and processing-specific periods: [INFORMATION PENDING].

Security and rights

The platform uses access control and organization/product boundaries; no system guarantees absolute security. Subject to statutory conditions, you may request access, a copy, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or object to processing, and withdraw consent when applicable. Contact the mailbox above. Identity checks are proportionate; workspace requests may require action by the relevant organization. You may complain to the Serbian Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection. Data protection officer status and postal channel: [INFORMATION PENDING].

Children and changes

Rules for minors and processing of children’s data: [INFORMATION PENDING]. Children’s and special-category data require separate assessment and lawful authorization. Changes are published with a version and date; use the contact email above.
